flagged.evidence: The step says the maximum is attained “at r=λ'_{k+1} (at r=0 when k≥λ'_1, with the convention λ'_{k+1}=0).” For λ=(2) and k=1, k≥λ'_1=1, but λ'_2=1 and max_{r≥0}(Σ_{i≤r}λ_i−rk)=1, attained at r=1, not r=0. The parenthetical is false (the main maximum formula remains valid).

The proof says that if A_{ii}v=0, “the block column computation ... shows that p annihilates” the vector supported on block I_i. An upper block-triangular column also has entries in earlier blocks: for α=(1,1), p=[[1,1],[0,0]] and v=1 in block 2 give A_{22}v=0 but p(0,v)=(1,0)≠0. This does not establish injectivity of A_{ii}; block-triangular determinant or elimination would close the gap.

The step says the dimensions determine the “whole southwest rank matrix” because they determine r_{i+1,j} for all i,j and r_{n+1,j}=0. Those data give rows 2 through n and the zero row, but not row 1. Since x=h^{-1}g and x'=h'^{-1}g' are invertible, r_{1,j}(x)=r_{1,j}(x')=j; stating this fact completes the inference.
